messages:
maria_support: FYI — customer acme-studies reports free-trial credits didn't decrement after two generation calls. They did ~3k tokens but balance still shows full trial. Any known issues?

aya_billing: Thanks — do you have request IDs or example timestamps I can look up?

maria_support: Pasted their snippet from the dashboard: `req_01F7X0X9J0A2B8Y1` and `req_01F7X0Y2K3L4M5N6` (calls at 2024-11-03T18:12Z and 2024-11-03T18:15Z). Customer says responses are valid and quick.

sam_engineering: Can you dump the gateway logs around those IDs? Also did they use an idempotency key?

maria_support: They said they didn't set an idempotency key. Here's the gateway trace I grabbed:```
[2024-11-03T18:12:23Z] req_01F7X0X9J0A2B8Y1 -> 200 cached-edge-response (short-circuit)
[2024-11-03T18:12:23Z] billing-hook SKIPPED (edge: short-circuit path)
[2024-11-03T18:15:02Z] req_01F7X0Y2K3L4M5N6 -> 200 real-runtime
[2024-11-03T18:15:02Z] billing-hook EMITTED (runtime)
```

jess_devops: whoa that billing-hook skipped line is a red flag. Edge cache short-circuits should still emit usage events. Did we recently change the edge lambda?

sam_engineering: We shipped an optimization last week that returns cached responses directly from the gateway to shave latency; looks like we accidentally gated the billing event behind a runtime path. Bug.

aya_billing: Ok — if that path returns and never emits, customer won't be charged. We need to reconcile and then decide credit action.

maria_support: Customer is asking for immediate correction — they want to be charged correctly or have usage reflected (they're fine paying but worry about ledger mismatch).

sam_engineering: Quick mitigation: re-enable billing hook on gateway for cached responses. Patching now. I'll also add a reconciliation job to scan gateway logs for SKIPPED events and emit missing usage events.

billing-bot: deploy:gateway-billing-patch started by @sam_engineering at 2024-11-03T19:02Z. CI checks passed.

jess_devops: Patch deployed to prod-edge in us-west at 2024-11-03T19:05Z.

aya_billing: For customer response: offer two things — 1) run a backfill to emit usage events so their trial balance reflects real usage (no charge beyond trial), 2) if ledger reconciliation fails or impossible, offer manual adjustment to match the observed token usage. Which do we prefer?

maria_support: I'll offer the backfill first and keep manual adjustment as fallback. Also asked customer for permission to run reconciliation on their account.

sam_engineering: Backfill command (internal):```
# scan gateway logs and emit missing usage events for account acme-studies
./tools/usage_backfill --account acme-studies --since 2024-11-03T00:00Z --dry-run
# when verified
./tools/usage_backfill --account acme-studies --since 2024-11-03T00:00Z --apply
```

jess_devops: Ran dry-run, found one skipped event matching req_01F7X0X9J0A2B8Y1 -> would emit ~1500 tokens. Ready to apply after customer OK.

maria_support: Customer OK'd the backfill. Running apply now and will confirm balance after ledger job finishes.

billing-bot: backfill:usage_event_emitted for req_01F7X0X9J0A2B8Y1 (1500 tokens) at 2024-11-03T19:28Z. Ledger delta scheduled.

maria_support: Update to customer — backfill applied, their trial balance now shows ~1500 tokens used (matches their expectations). They thanked us. Closing once ledger fully reconciled. :tada:

sam_engineering: Follow-ups: 1) add automated test to ensure gateway cached path always triggers billing hook 2) add an alert if billing-hook SKIPPED occurs >0 in prod 3) schedule a short postmortem doc.

jess_devops: Filed infra ticket INFRA-981: "edge billing hook short-circuit" with remediation steps.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer and noting refund policy not needed since backfill reflected correct trial usage. Thanks all :heart:
